topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Rain's drumming a lonesome tune outside my window, the kind that makes a man polish his glass a little too often. Got a message from a client, told me her online friend, the one she's been chatting to for what feels like forever, turned out to be right here, same city. Stranger things, sure, but there's something in the way it happened, a twist in the story that doesn't quite sit right. Didn't take much to see the flicker in her eyes, the hope crinkled at the edges. Been thinking about what she told me, the way the rain blurs the view outside, makes everything a little less clear. Gonna need to dig deeper, see what shakes out. Rain's not stopping anytime soon, neither am I.
